notes: A log entry can no longer be cut without saying so. Prompts are recorded up to 12,000 characters — several times longer than anything the app assembles — and if a line ever is trimmed it now ends by naming how many characters went missing, instead of just stopping mid-sentence the way the old 500-character cap did. The size budget added in the previous build also can no longer erase the entry it was called to record: an oversized line is kept rather than swept away with the history it overflowed.
